preconditions.expression: len(P) > 0 and len(T) > 0 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in P) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: Both strings P and T are non-empty and consist only of lowercase English letters.
The lengths of P and T are each at most 10^4.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7, representing the number of valid ways modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= pos < len(T) - len(P) + 1 for pos in [i for i in range(len(T) - len(P) + 1) if T.startswith(P, i)])
postconditions.description: All starting positions of occurrences of P in T are valid indices in the range [0, len(T) - len(P)).

postconditions.expression:
let occurrences = [i for i in range(len(T) - len(P) + 1) if T.startswith(P, i)]
    let valid_subsets = [subset for subset in [s for s in range(1, 1 << len(occurrences))] if any(1 << i & subset for i in range(len(occurrences)))]
    let product_valid = [all(1 <= pos <= len(T) for pos in [occurrences[i] for i in range(len(occurrences)) if 1 << i & subset]) and
                        all(1 <= (product([occurrences[i] for i in range(len(occurrences)) if 1 << i & subset]) % 9) <= 9 for _ in range(9)) and
                        all((product([occurrences[i] for i in range(len(occurrences)) if 1 << i & subset]) % d) == 0 for d in range(1, 10))]
    let count = sum(1 for subset in valid_subsets if product_valid[subset - 1])
    int(stdout) == count % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of non-empty subsets of starting positions of P in T where the product of the positions is divisible by all integers from 1 to 9 (i.e., a 'good' number), modulo 10^9 + 7.
